en: Black‑and‑white view of a large public square packed with people attending a festive procession or celebration. Many women wear traditional dresses and carry parasols; men wear dark suits and hats. The façades of several 3‑ to 4‑story townhouses line the square, heavily decorated with garlands, wreaths and large vertical striped flags. A maypole‑like pole with ribbons stands near the center. The architecture is Central European, late 19th–early 20th century. Some shop signs are faintly visible on the buildings.
